query: How do I replace batteries in thermostat?

goal.title: Replace the thermostat batteries and restore its display
goal.description: Detach the thermostat, open its battery cover with a screwdriver after trying a butter knife, and remove the two old cells. Handle and wipe the removed batteries, release them into a bin, then insert replacement cells from a pack. Inspect the blank display, remove and rotate one cell, reinstall it, close the cover, verify that digits appear, and reattach the thermostat to the wall.
goal.final_state: The thermostat is mounted on the wall with digits visible; the person has pressed its controls and withdrawn their hands.

procedure.description: Remove the thermostat from the wall and inspect its back. Try levering the battery cover with a butter knife, fetch a screwdriver, pry the cover free and put both cover and screwdriver on the stool.

Remove both batteries and put the thermostat down. Collect the cells in the left hand, rub their terminals with a cotton swab, pick the thermostat up again, carry the removed cells to the bin and return to the stool.
Take two cells from the battery pack and insert them sequentially. Pick up the cover, turn the thermostat between front and back, and inspect its display and battery placement.
Remove one of the inserted cells, rotate it while holding the cover, put it back and press the cover into place.
Inspect the display after digits appear, align the thermostat with its wall mount and release it. Press the lower and upper controls, then leave the mounted thermostat in view.
